verdict.rationale: Wave's pricing docs say the Pro plan is billed per business, with each business signed up and subscribed separately. That implies several entities can be kept as separate books, and per-entity P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow reports exist. Nothing in the evidence shows consolidated financials across entities, and Wave positions itself as built for small business owners, not accountants. Missing for 10: consolidated reporting across entities, intercompany eliminations, a documented multi-entity management workflow, and independent corroboration.
